summary: Frégate Island Airport is a small private airstrip on Frégate Island, one of the Seychelles' most exclusive private island resorts, currently marked as unusable for regular aviation operations. The island is renowned for its luxury eco-resort and conservation programs that protect endemic species such as the Seychelles magpie-robin and giant Aldabra tortoises. Its restricted status reflects the highly exclusive, low-impact nature of the destination.
